assistworld-assist-world:lever:aa5b4537-.title: Business Development Representative
assistworld-assist-world:lever:aa5b4537-.description: About the Role We’re looking for a confident, highly articulate Sales Caller / Business Development Representative to support a targeted outbound calling campaign. This is not a high-volume cold-calling role. You’ll be speaking with senior decision-makers at established businesses, including CEOs, COOs, Chairmen, and Founders. The target list is highly targeted and carefully researched, so your ability to communicate professionally, build rapport quickly, and deliver a concise, compelling message is critical. You’ll be provided with a punchy, well-developed script and a focused list of prospects. Your role will be to confidently make outbound calls, engage senior executives, and create opportunities for further conversations. Key Responsibilities ● Make outbound calls to a highly targeted list of business executives ● Speak confidently and naturally with CEOs, COOs, Founders, Chairmen, and other senior decision-makers ● Follow and deliver a structured sales script while keeping conversations conversational ● Quickly establish rapport and credibility over the phone ● Handle initial objections professionally and confidently ● Accurately record call outcomes and prospect information ● Maintain consistent activity and follow-up throughout the week ● Work closely with the business owner and follow feedback to continuously improve performance.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:60c51a3f-87e7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Reporting Analyst based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to turn complex operational data into clear, actionable business insights. You will work across multiple data sources, business functions, and brands to strengthen reporting and decision-making. The position combines data analysis, dashboard development, business requirements gathering, and technical problem-solving. You will help establish reliable reporting and a consistent view of operational performance across quality, service, cost, and productivity metrics. Working closely with business stakeholders and Business Intelligence teams, you will translate evolving needs into effective reporting solutions. The role provides exposure to the full project lifecycle, from analysis and design through deployment and ongoing support. Based in Carlsbad, California, it also offers the possibility of working from home up to two days per week. Transform data from SAP and non-SAP sources into accurate, actionable information that supports operational and business decisions. Design, develop, and maintain business intelligence reports and dashboards using SAP BusinessObjects, including Web Intelligence or Crystal Reports, and Microsoft Power BI. Write SQL queries, stored procedures, and data extraction logic to support reporting, dashboarding, and data analysis. Analyze and troubleshoot discrepancies between reporting outputs and source transactional systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency. Establish and maintain a reliable view of operational performance metrics, including quality, service, cost, productivity, and other key business indicators. Gather reporting requirements from business stakeholders, translate high-level needs into functional requirements, and create clear technical specifications. Support all phases of reporting and analytics projects, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, post-production support, and maintenance. Partner closely with Business Intelligence, IT, management, and other internal stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, resolve reporting challenges, and improve information delivery. Manage multiple reporting solutions and concurrent projects across different business areas while communicating progress, risks, and priorities to senior stakeholders. Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting workflows, data processes, dashboards, and overall business visibility. Ensure reporting solutions follow established standards and best practices for stability, reliability, and availability. Think beyond immediate reporting requests by anticipating additional information and visibility needs that could help stakeholders make better decisions. Represent the North American operations function effectively across organizational levels, including senior leadership and international teams. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or another related quantitative field. At least 1 year of experience in business or operational data analysis involving structured datasets and stakeholder-facing reporting deliverables. At least 1 year of experience designing and developing reporting solutions using SAP BusinessObjects, including Web Intelligence or Crystal Reports, and SQL. Hands-on experience writing SQL queries, stored procedures, or other data extraction logic for reporting and dashboard development. Experience working with relational databases and validating data accuracy across multiple source systems. Demonstrated ability to validate reporting results against transactional or source-system data and investigate data mismatches. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c203c09e-0f38-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Latvian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Canada. This is an opportunity for an experienced Latvian voice professional to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice technologies. You’ll use your expertise in pronunciation, tone, pacing, and emotional expression to create and evaluate high-quality training data. Our Classroom Intelligence tools connect teachers, students, and curriculum—making meaningful learning happen in classrooms every day. We believe the best technology is cutting-edge, respects teachers’ time, integrates into real classrooms, and helps educators focus on what matters most. Since launching, Brisk has experienced rapid growth. Over 2 million teachers use our platform, and we partner with districts and schools nationwide to transform how educators teach and how students learn. We're backed by leading venture and edtech investors including Bessemer Venture Partners (Shopify, LinkedIn, Anthropic, Perplexity) and Owl Ventures (Newsela, Quizlet, MasterClass), with a team spanning top AI companies and real classroom experience. We're a fast-moving, collaborative team driven by a shared commitment to educator impact and product excellence. Our values—urgency, ownership, and focus—shape how we build and who we are. THE OPPORTUNITY: We’re looking for a dynamic and results-driven SMB Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing new school and district partnerships. You’ll play a critical part in expanding Brisk’s footprint, working closely with potential clients to understand their needs and demonstrate how Brisk’s solutions can enhance their teaching and learning outcomes. YOU WILL: - Lead Generation & Outreach: Identify and prospect new school and district accounts through targeted outreach, leveraging existing networks, and participating in educational events. - Sales Process Management: Guide prospective clients through the sales journey, from initial contact to closing, ensuring clear communication and a tailored approach. - Relationship Building: Develop strong relationships with education leaders, understanding their challenges and goals, and positioning Brisk’s offerings as valuable solutions. - Travel: Travel approximately 10-20% of the time to meet with prospective schools and districts, attend educational conferences in the territory, and represent Brisk at industry events. - Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process and a seamless transition from prospect to customer. - Market Insights: Gather insights from potential customers to share with our product and leadership teams, helping shape future product developments and strategies. - CRM Management: Accurately track and update prospect interactions and pipeline activity in our CRM system (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot). - Achieve and Exceed Goals: Meet or exceed key performance indicators (KPIs), such as outreach targets, lead conversion rates, and revenue booking contributions. YOU HAVE: - BA or BS in any field. - Sales Experience: 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, lead generation, or a related role, preferably in SaaS or EdTech. - Tools Experience: Prior familiarity, and ideally work experience, with Salesforce, Gong, and Outreach. - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to connect with diverse stakeholders. - Customer-Focused: Passionate about understanding and solving customer challenges, with a genuine interest in K-12 education. - Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment. - Team-Oriented: Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the best outcomes for our clients and company.
